QUOTE: By default it expands to `private_##member`, so a field such as `mbedtls_aes_context::MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` (`include/mbedtls/aes.h:64`) is declared as `private_nr`. ... If the symbol is not defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` renames the member. If it is defined, the macro expands to the bare member name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the default expansion is `private_##member` (renaming to `private_nr`), and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the bare member name.
